note: The Taliban's national spirits (gameplay values). They go with the movement: from AFG to the TAL insurgency in December 2001 and back to AFG at the takeover (the hand_over effect).

spirits.name: The Leadership Council
spirits.description: The movement's leadership council, also called the Quetta Shura, directs it.

spirits.name: Shadow government
spirits.description: Shadow governors and courts work in the districts the movement controls or contests.

spirits.name: Rural networks
spirits.description: Support and recruits in the villages of the south and east.

spirits.name: A war economy
spirits.description: Levies on trade and farming, including the opium trade, fund the movement.

spirits.name: The military track
spirits.description: The movement seeks victory on the battlefield.
